scope: Necessary fit and anti-rotation bounds; not a proof of complete joint fit.
stop: Analytic necessary conditions only; do not enlarge pockets or choose a manufacturing tolerance to force a pass.
assumptions: All listed bore/shaft/AF sizes nominal; tolerances unknown
Bracket bore and nut pocket concentric; no relative error
Rigid perpendicular screws and equal diagonal error
Print errors are sensitivity inputs, not claimed printer capability
relations: W < nut across-corners minimum is necessary to rule out free in-plane nut rotation in an open parallel-wall slot
excluded: Nut torque capacity, tilt, chamfers, insertion, retention
